display_long_description:
🚀 THE COSMOS IS YOUR AMUSEMENT PARK

Take your seat, pull down the bar and get ready for liftoff. Cosmic Roller Coaster takes you on a roller coaster ride with nothing beneath you but space.

🪐 RIDE THROUGH THE UNIVERSE

Race through the solar system from Neptune all the way to the Sun. Swoop over the rings of a gas giant beneath glowing auroras, and weave through an asteroid belt. Skim past the Sun’s blazing flares, plunge through colorful nebulae.

🎢 SIT BACK AND ENJOY THE VIEW

In Tour mode, all you have to do is hang on. Float gently past the planets on one coaster, then hurtle through the stars at breakneck speed on the next. Every coaster has its own pace, and every one has a view you won’t forget.

🔫 OR TAKE AIM

Want more than the view? Switch to Arcade mode, grab a laser gun and shoot targets as you tear down the track. The more you hit, the higher your score.

🏆 CHASE THE PERFECT RUN

Every coaster has three ranks to earn. Finish the ride, beat the score, then go for the perfect run. Steady hands and a good aim will get you there.

🌌 THERE’S ALWAYS MORE OUT THERE

New coasters keep arriving, each one taking you somewhere new in space.

✨ Hold on tight. The universe is waiting.
